brief.en: Damages all zombies in a 3x3 area
brief.zh: 对 3x3 范围内所有僵尸造成伤害

description.en: Gloom Shrooms shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions. When powered and shooting, they power near by shadow plants.
description.zh: 忧郁菇向八个方向发射孢子，对僵尸造成伤害。在发射时如果被激活，也会激活附近的暗影植物。

chat.en: Some see him as depressed, but he's got a lot of sides.
chat.zh: 很多人觉得他很忧郁，但实际上他有很多副面孔。

text.en: powers shadow plants in an area when shooting
text.zh: 攻击时激活范围内的暗影植物
